selectionFoundation.objective: Meet task-specific quality and authority requirements with defensible total delivery cost and latency.
decisionSequence: Describe task capability, proof novelty, integration breadth, context needs, risk, required tools, quality floor and delivery deadline before dispatch.
Filter candidates by admitted role/route, available tools, context and required capabilities. Worker observations do not qualify an orchestrator/reviewer.
Attach dated official identity/pricing and relevant independent benchmark configurations; label provider-reported scores separately. Unknown matches remain unknown.
Use comparable local tranche evidence to estimate acceptance quality, self-repair, redispatch, review burden and elapsed time; account for task/scaffold confounders.
Choose among candidates meeting the quality floor using cost/latency/reliability tradeoffs and uncertainty. No permanent model-to-task-family mapping or invented universal weights.
Freeze rationale, alternatives, unknowns and actual operator choice before the next transfer; compare forecast with reviewed return and update the existing ledger.

costAccounting.unitDiscipline: Track monetary cost and human/agent elapsed time separately. Monetize time only with an explicit rate; do not add dollars to minutes.
